# Infraestrutura compartilhada

Os esquemas SQL são dumps sem dados dos bancos do original congelado
`46b89c1d5519aeae40c088ee94262e9b739a7d48`. As funções SQL do forms fazem
parte dessa infraestrutura e não precisam ser reimplementadas. O banco do
prejanus também já existe, com o esquema fornecido. Não criar, apagar ou
migrar tabelas na inicialização da aplicação.

Os demais SQLs são os dados declarativos da fixture; o formulário JSON
documenta as seções, campos, tipos e rótulos. Esses arquivos explicam o
contrato dos bancos, não substituem consultas: ler as respostas e os
usuários dos bancos, e os anexos do volume, sem fixar valores da fixture
no código. As fixtures já são carregadas pelo avaliador antes de iniciar
a aplicação.

A aplicação recebe as variáveis de ambiente do original:

- `DB_CONNECTION_STRING`: URL SQLAlchemy `postgresql+psycopg://...` do banco
  do prejanus.
- `DB_CONNECTION_STRING_FORMS`: mesma forma de URL, com usuário de leitura
  do banco do forms.
- `APP_ENV` e `DEV_USER_ID`: o atalho de autenticação vale somente quando
  `APP_ENV=local`. Sem o atalho e sem sessão, responder 401 nas rotas
  protegidas.
- Os arquivos enviados ficam em `/shared/uploads/`.

Os serviços compartilham a rede Docker `shared_network`; o host do banco
nessa rede é `db`, porta 5432. Credenciais e nomes dos bancos vêm das URLs
de ambiente. O avaliador pode selecionar outros bancos com os mesmos
esquemas e dados.

`GET /` deve responder 200. O módulo de entrada é `app.py`, exportando
`app`, uma aplicação FastAPI.

O docente deve obter os dados do edital, a inscrição e seu nome a partir
das respostas do forms e do mapeamento da versão em `edict_form_mappings`.
No JSON dos editais, expor o formulário de candidatura como
`candidate_form_id` (texto). O detalhe da inscrição contém `summary`
(incluindo `name` e `email`) e `submission_form`, uma lista de seções com
`fields`; cada campo contém `id`, `name`, `label`, `type` e `value`.
Preservar em `value` a representação textual gravada pelo forms, inclusive
o JSON textual das caixas de seleção. Não substituir as respostas por
valores de exemplo.

Para baixar um arquivo, verificar a inscrição e se o nome solicitado
pertence à resposta do campo informado; impedir caminhos fora do volume.

Ponytail: nível **full**, na revisão congelada. As regras do grupo
baseline prevalecem sobre qualquer skill: implementar sem escrever ou
executar testes, sem pedir esclarecimentos e sem feedback de avaliação.

8:         --profile develop --profile clamav "$@"
9: }

12:     cp .env.example .env
13:     cp prejanus-back/.env.example prejanus-back/.env
14:     sed 's|^NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=.*|NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost|' prejanus-front/.env.example > prejanus-front/.env
15:     sed -e 's/^#USE_CLAMAV=.*/USE_CLAMAV=1/' -e '/^DEV_USER_EMAIL=/d' forms/.env.example > forms/.env
16: 
17:     # mesmos donos que bin/deploy.sh, sem sudo
18:     docker run --rm -v "$PWD/docker:/d" alpine sh -c '
19:         mkdir -p /d/postgres_data /d/redis_cache /d/shared_tmp /d/clamd_socket /d/shared_uploads
20:         chown -R 999:999 /d/postgres_data /d/redis_cache
21:         chown -R 1001:1001 /d/shared_tmp /d/clamd_socket /d/shared_uploads'
22: 
23:     (cd static-assets && npm ci && npm run build)
24: 
25:     # sem --build: o original é congelado, então só constrói imagem ausente e não volta ao Docker Hub
26:     log=$(mktemp)
27:     dc --progress plain up -d --wait 2>&1 | tee "$log"
28:     curl -sf --retry 30 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 2 http://localhost:8083/ > /dev/null

32:     {
33:         sed -nE 's/.*FROM (docker\.io\/[^ ]+@sha256:[0-9a-f]+).*/\1/p' "$log"
34:         docker image inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' redis rnwood/smtp4dev alpine
35:         cat ../demos/caronte/imagens.txt

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# uso: caronte.sh subir | trocar admin|teacher | consulta | cobertura
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../caronte-core"

dc() {
    docker compose --project-directory . -f docker-compose.yml -f ../demos/caronte/compose.yml \
        --profile develop --profile clamav "$@"
}

subir() {
    cp .env.example .env
    cp prejanus-back/.env.example prejanus-back/.env
    sed 's|^NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=.*|NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost|' prejanus-front/.env.example > prejanus-front/.env
    sed -e 's/^#USE_CLAMAV=.*/USE_CLAMAV=1/' -e '/^DEV_USER_EMAIL=/d' forms/.env.example > forms/.env

    # mesmos donos que bin/deploy.sh, sem sudo
    docker run --rm -v "$PWD/docker:/d" alpine sh -c '
        mkdir -p /d/postgres_data /d/redis_cache /d/shared_tmp /d/clamd_socket /d/shared_uploads
        chown -R 999:999 /d/postgres_data /d/redis_cache
        chown -R 1001:1001 /d/shared_tmp /d/clamd_socket /d/shared_uploads'

    (cd static-assets && npm ci && npm run build)

    # sem --build: o original é congelado, então só constrói imagem ausente e não volta ao Docker Hub
    log=$(mktemp)
    dc --progress plain up -d --wait 2>&1 | tee "$log"
    curl -sf --retry 30 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 2 http://localhost:8083/ > /dev/null
    dc exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U caronte_prejanus -d caronte_prejanus < ../demos/caronte/seed.sql

    # bases do build não ficam no image store; o digest vem do log, e o que não foi reconstruído mantém o registro anterior
    {
        sed -nE 's/.*FROM (docker\.io\/[^ ]+@sha256:[0-9a-f]+).*/\1/p' "$log"
        docker image inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' redis rnwood/smtp4dev alpine
        cat ../demos/caronte/imagens.txt
    } | sort -s -u -t@ -k1,1 > "$log.imagens"
    mv "$log.imagens" ../demos/caronte/imagens.txt
}

trocar() {
    case "${1:-}" in
        admin) id=1 ;;
        teacher) id=2 ;;
        *) echo "uso: $0 trocar admin|teacher" >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    DEV_USER_ID=$id dc up -d --no-deps prejanus-back
}

imagem=caronte-core-prejanus-back:latest
uvicorn=(uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000)

backend() {
    local porta=$1; shift
    docker rm -f "prejanus-back-consulta-$porta" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
    docker run -d --rm --name "prejanus-back-consulta-$porta" --network shared_network -p "$porta:8000" \
        -e DB_CONNECTION_STRING=postgresql+psycopg://caronte_prejanus:caronte_prejanus@db:5432/caronte_prejanus_consulta \
        -e DB_CONNECTION_STRING_FORMS=postgresql+psycopg://caronte_forms_reader:caronte_forms_reader@db:5432/caronte_forms_consulta \
        -v "$PWD/../demos/caronte/uploads-consulta:/shared/uploads:ro" "$@" > /dev/null
    curl -sf --retry 30 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 1 "http://localhost:$porta/" > /dev/null
}

consulta() {
    local admin d=../demos/caronte
    admin=$(sed -n 's/^POSTGRES_ADMIN_USER=//p' .env)
    docker rm -f prejanus-back-consulta-8093 prejanus-back-consulta-8094 > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
    dc exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -U "$admin" -d postgres \
        -c "drop database if exists caronte_forms_consulta" \
        -c "drop database if exists caronte_prejanus_consulta" \
        -c "create database caronte_forms_consulta owner caronte_forms" \
        -c "create database caronte_prejanus_consulta owner caronte_prejanus" \
        -c "grant connect on database caronte_forms_consulta to caronte_forms_reader"
    for b in forms prejanus; do
        dc exec -T db pg_dump -s -U "$admin" "caronte_$b" |
            dc exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -U "$admin" -d "caronte_${b}_consulta" > /dev/null
    done
    carga() { dc exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q --single-transaction -U "caronte_$1" -d "caronte_$1_consulta" > /dev/null; }
    carga forms < $d/fixture-forms.sql
    carga forms < $d/fixture-consulta-forms.sql
    carga prejanus < $d/seed.sql
    carga prejanus < $d/fixture-prejanus.sql
    carga prejanus < $d/fixture-consulta-prejanus.sql

    backend 8093 -e APP_ENV=local -e DEV_USER_ID=2 "$imagem" "${uvicorn[@]}"
    # sem o atalho DEV_USER_ID, para conferir o 401 sem sessão
    backend 8094 -e APP_ENV=sem-atalho "$imagem" "${uvicorn[@]}"
}

cobertura() {
    # coverage do venv de demos/ montado na imagem congelada: mesmo Python 3.11 e glibc
    local out=$PWD/../demos/caronte/.cobertura
    local cov=(-v "$PWD/../demos/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/coverage:/cov/coverage:ro" -e PYTHONPATH=/cov
               -v "$out:/out" -e COVERAGE_FILE=/out/.coverage -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)")
    mkdir -p "$out"
    consulta
    backend 8093 -e APP_ENV=local -e DEV_USER_ID=2 "${cov[@]}" "$imagem" \
        python -m coverage run --source=src --omit='*/tests/*,*/migrations/*,*conftest.py' -m "${uvicorn[@]}"
    (cd ../demos && uv run pytest caronte/oraculo -q)
    docker stop prejanus-back-consulta-8093 > /dev/null
    docker run --rm "${cov[@]}" "$imagem" python -m coverage json -q -o /out/cobertura.json
    (cd ../demos && uv run python caronte/cobertura.py caronte/.cobertura/cobertura.json)
    backend 8093 -e APP_ENV=local -e DEV_USER_ID=2 "$imagem" "${uvicorn[@]}"
}

case "${1:-}" in
    subir) subir ;;
    trocar) trocar "${2:-}" ;;
    consulta) consulta ;;
    cobertura) cobertura ;;
    *) echo "uso: $0 subir | trocar admin|teacher | consulta | cobertura" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware
from senhaunicapy import SenhaUnica

from src.routers.auth_routers import router as auth_router
from src.routers.edict_routers import router as edict_router
from src.routers.forms_routers import router as forms_router
from src.routers.submission_routers import router as submission_router
from src.settings import get_settings

settings = get_settings()
app = FastAPI()

app.add_middleware(
    SessionMiddleware, 
    secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,
    max_age=60 * 60 * 8,
    same_site="lax",
    https_only=True, 
    )

app.state.config = {
    "SENHAUNICA_OAUTH_HOST": settings.SENHAUNICA_OAUTH_HOST,
    "SENHAUNICA_REQUEST_TOKEN_RESOURCE": settings.SENHAUNICA_REQUEST_TOKEN_RESOURCE,
    "SENHAUNICA_CONSUMER_KEY": settings.SENHAUNICA_CONSUMER_KEY,
    "SENHAUNICA_CONSUMER_SECRET": settings.SENHAUNICA_CONSUMER_SECRET,
    "SENHAUNICA_AUTHORIZE_URL": settings.SENHAUNICA_AUTHORIZE_URL,
    "SENHAUNICA_ACCESS_TOKEN_RESOURCE": settings.SENHAUNICA_ACCESS_TOKEN_RESOURCE,
    "SENHAUNICA_CALLBACK_ID": settings.SENHAUNICA_CALLBACK_ID
}

senhaunica = SenhaUnica()
senhaunica.init_app(app)

app.include_router(edict_router)
app.include_router(submission_router)
app.include_router(auth_router)
app.include_router(forms_router)

if settings.BACKEND_CORS_ORIGINS:
    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=[
            origin for origin in settings.BACKEND_CORS_ORIGINS.split(",")
        ],
        allow_credentials=True,
        allow_methods=["*"],
        allow_headers=["*"],
    )

@app.get("/")
async def root():
    return {"message": "Hello World"}

)
async def get_all(
    auth_user: UserDTO = Depends(get_user),  # force auth route
    session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session),
    type: str | None = Query(None, description="Filter by type of edict."),
    is_open: bool | None = Query(None, description="Filter by open/closed edicts."),
):
    edicts = await get_all_edicts(session, type=type, is_open=is_open)
    return edicts

)
async def get_all_submissions_from_edict(
    edict_id: int,
    stats: str | None = None,
    only_favorites: bool | None = Query(
        False,
        description="Filter to only show favorite submissions of a specific user.",
    ),
    auth_user: UserDTO = Depends(get_user),
    session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session),
    session_forms: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session_forms),
):
    user_id = None
    if only_favorites:
        user_id = auth_user.id
    submissions = await query_get_all_submissions_from_edict(
        session, session_forms, edict_id, auth_user.id, user_id, stats
    )
    return {"submissions": submissions}

from pydantic import BaseModel
from datetime import datetime, date
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from typing import Optional
from src.infra.database.models.edict import Edict
from src.infra.database.models.user_edict_slots import UserEdictSlots
from src.use_cases.dtos import UserDTO
from src.use_cases.submission.exceptions import EdictNotFound


class EdictPhaseResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    closed_date: Optional[date] = None
    phase: str
    

class EdictByIdSchema(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    candidate_form_id: str
    recommender_form_id: str
    description: str
    closed_date: Optional[date] = None
    created_at: Optional[datetime] = None
    year: int
    semester: int
    type: str
    is_open: bool
    updated_at: Optional[datetime] = None
    phase: str
    phases: list[EdictPhaseResponse]
    slots: str


async def get_edict_by_id(session: AsyncSession, edict_id: int, user: UserDTO) -> EdictByIdSchema:
    edict_query = select(Edict).where(Edict.id == edict_id)
    edict_result = await session.execute(edict_query)
    edict = edict_result.scalar_one_or_none()

    if edict is None:
        raise EdictNotFound(edict_id)

    slot_query = (
        select(UserEdictSlots)
        .where(UserEdictSlots.edict_id == edict_id)
        .where((UserEdictSlots.user_id == user.id) | (UserEdictSlots.user_id.is_(None)))
    )
    slot_result = await session.execute(slot_query)
    slot = slot_result.scalar_one_or_none()

    return EdictByIdSchema(
        id=edict.id,
        title=edict.title,
        candidate_form_id=edict.candidate_forms,
        recommender_form_id=edict.recommenders_forms,
        description=edict.description,
        closed_date=edict.closed_date,
        created_at=edict.created_at,
        year=edict.year,
        semester=edict.semester,
        type=edict.type,
        is_open=edict.is_open,
        updated_at=edict.updated_at,
        phase=edict.phase,
        phases=[
            EdictPhaseResponse(
                id=__phase.id,
                closed_date=__phase.closed_date,
                phase=__phase.phase
            ) for __phase in edict.edict_phases
        ],
        slots="0" if slot is None else str(slot.slots)
    )

import json
from http import HTTPStatus
from fastapi import HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy import select, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import joinedload
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert

from src.infra.database.models.edict import Edict
from src.infra.database.models.edict_form_mapping import EdictFormMapping
from src.infra.database.models.favorites import Favorites
from src.infra.database.models.labels import Labels
from src.infra.database.models.submission import StatsEnum, Submission
from src.infra.database.models.user import User
from src.use_cases.exceptions import InvalidMappingError
from src.use_cases.submission.change_semester import process_semester
from src.use_cases.submission.get_by_id import (
    get_accept_info,
    get_submissions_forms_by_id,
)
from src.use_cases.submission.schemas import (
    AcceptSchema,
    BiddingEnum,
    BiddingUserSchema,
    BiddingUsersSchema,
    GraduationSchema as BaseGraduationSchema,
    LabelSchema,
    PosCompSchema,
    ResearchFieldsSchema,
    ResearchSchema,
    SubmissionApprovalSchema as BaseSubmissionSchema,
    UserSchema,
)
from src.utils import str_for_bool
from src.utils.map_candidate import build_lookup, resolve_mapping


class GraduationSchema(BaseGraduationSchema):
    pass


class SubmissionSchema(BaseSubmissionSchema):
    pass


class GetAllSubmissionsFromEdictResponse(BaseModel):
    submissions: list[SubmissionSchema]


def get_value(mapped_values, name, default_value=None):
    """Helpers agora opera sobre o dict já resolvido pelo resolve_mapping."""
    val = mapped_values.get(name)
    return val if val is not None else default_value


def get_biddings_from_edict(labels, approvals_by_user, edict_id):
    bidding = {status.value: [] for status in BiddingEnum}

    for label in labels:
        if label.context_type != "bidding":
            continue

        user = label.user
        slot_entry = next(
            (slot for slot in user.edicts_with_slots if slot.edict_id == edict_id), None
        )
        total_slots = slot_entry.slots if slot_entry else 0
        approvals = approvals_by_user.get(user.id, 0)
        slots_rest = (total_slots or 0) - (approvals or 0)

        if label.label in bidding:
            bidding[label.label].append(
                BiddingUserSchema(
                    id=user.id, name=user.name, email=user.email, slots=str(slots_rest)
                )
            )
    return bidding


async def query_get_all_submissions_from_edict(
    session: AsyncSession,
    session_forms: AsyncSession,
    edict_id: int,
    auth_user_id: int,
    user_id: str | None = None,
    stats: str | None = None,
) -> list[SubmissionSchema]:

    # busca o edict
    query_result = await session.execute(select(Edict).where(Edict.id == edict_id))
    edict: Edict = query_result.scalars().one_or_none()
    if edict is None:
        return []

    # busca submissions dos formulários externos
    base_query = text("""
        select * from get_all_submissions(
            cast(:p_form_id as int),
            cast(:p_order_by as int),
            cast(:p_order_type as int),
            cast(:p_search as text),
            cast(:p_lang as text)
        )
    """)
    base_params = {
        "p_form_id": int(edict.recommenders_forms),
        "p_order_by": 1,
        "p_order_type": 0,
        "p_search": "",
        "p_lang": "pt",
    }

    all_recommenders = await session_forms.execute(base_query, base_params)
    recommenders_forms_submissions = [
        dict(row._mapping) for row in all_recommenders.fetchall()
    ]

    recommenders_by_email = {}
    for r in recommenders_forms_submissions:
        responses = r.get("responses", [])
        r["_responses_dict"] = {k: v for d in responses for k, v in d.items()}
        email = r.get("email")
        if email and str(email).strip():
            recommenders_by_email.setdefault(str(email).strip().lower(), []).append(r)

    base_params["p_form_id"] = int(edict.candidate_forms)
    all_candidates = await session_forms.execute(base_query, base_params)
    candidate_forms_submissions = [
        dict(row._mapping) for row in all_candidates.fetchall()
    ]

    # adicionar cada informação com lookup/mapping e recomendadores
    recommender_labels = ["recommended-email-1", "recommended-email-2"]

    # busca o form mapping do tipo candidate para este edict
    mapping_result = await session.execute(
        select(EdictFormMapping)
        .where(EdictFormMapping.edict_id == edict_id)
        .where(EdictFormMapping.form_type == "candidate")
    )

    edict_form_mappings = mapping_result.scalars().all()

    mappings_by_version = {
        mapping.form_version: mapping for mapping in edict_form_mappings
    }

    result = await session.execute(
        select(Submission).where(Submission.edict_id == edict_id)
    )

    submissions_by_candidate_form = {
        s.candidate_form_id: s for s in result.scalars().all()
    }

    for candidate_form in candidate_forms_submissions:
        submission = submissions_by_candidate_form.get(candidate_form["id"])
        if submission is None:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=500,
                detail=f"No Submission found for candidate form {candidate_form['id']}",
            )

        if submission.candidate_form_version not in mappings_by_version:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=500,
                detail=f"No candidate form mapping found for form version "
                f"{submission.candidate_form_version} (submission {submission.id})",
            )

        edict_form_mapping = mappings_by_version[submission.candidate_form_version]
        # resolve o mapeamento flexível — igual ao get_submission_by_id
        raw_form = await get_submissions_forms_by_id(
            candidate_form["id"], session_forms
        )
        lookup = build_lookup(raw_form)
        try:
            candidate_form["_mapped"] = resolve_mapping(
                edict_form_mapping.mapping,
                lookup,
            )
        except InvalidMappingError as e:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=HTTPStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail=str(e),
            )

        fullname = get_value(candidate_form["_mapped"], "name", "")
        candidate_form["recommenders"] = []
        for label in recommender_labels:
            email_recommender = get_value(candidate_form["_mapped"], label)
            if not email_recommender:
                continue
            for r in recommenders_by_email.get(email_recommender, []):
                r_fullname = (
                    r["_responses_dict"].get("fullname-candidate", {}).get("value", "")
                )
                if r_fullname == fullname:
                    candidate_form["recommenders"].append(r)

    # upsert submissions na base local
    insert_list = [
        {
            "edict_id": edict_id,
            "candidate_form_id": c["id"],
            "recommenders_form_ids": [r["id"] for r in c["recommenders"]],
            "entry_semester": process_semester(get_value(c["_mapped"], "semester", "")),
        }
        for c in candidate_forms_submissions
    ]

    if insert_list:
        stmt = insert(Submission).values(insert_list)
        stmt = stmt.on_conflict_do_update(
            index_elements=["candidate_form_id", "edict_id"],
            set_={"recommenders_form_ids": stmt.excluded.recommenders_form_ids},
        )
        await session.execute(stmt)
        await session.commit()

    # carrega submissions com labels/bidding
    candidate_form_ids = [item["candidate_form_id"] for item in insert_list]
    sub_query = (
        select(Submission)
        .where(Submission.edict_id == edict_id)
        .where(Submission.candidate_form_id.in_(candidate_form_ids))
        .options(
            joinedload(Submission.labels)
            .joinedload(Labels.user)
            .joinedload(User.edicts_with_slots),
            joinedload(Submission.advisor),
        )
    )
    if stats is not None:
        sub_query = sub_query.where(Submission.stats == stats.lower())

    all_submissions_result = await session.execute(sub_query)
    all_submissions = all_submissions_result.unique().scalars().all()
    submission_ids = [row.id for row in all_submissions]

    approvals_by_user: dict[int, int] = {}
    for submission in all_submissions:
        if submission.stats == StatsEnum.APPROVED.value and submission.advisor_id:
            approvals_by_user[submission.advisor_id] = (
                approvals_by_user.get(submission.advisor_id, 0) + 1
            )

    submission_mapping = {}
    for submission in all_submissions:
        advisor_name = submission.advisor.name if submission.advisor else ""
        advisor_email = submission.advisor.email if submission.advisor else ""
        bidding = get_biddings_from_edict(
            submission.labels, approvals_by_user, edict_id
        )
        accept = await get_accept_info(submission, session_forms)

        submission_mapping[submission.candidate_form_id] = {
            "id": submission.id,
            "labels": [
                label
                for label in submission.labels
                if label.context_type == "candidate" and label.user_id == auth_user_id
            ],
            "stats": submission.stats,
            "advisor_name": advisor_name,
            "advisor_email": advisor_email,
            "bidding": bidding,
            "accept": accept,
        }

    # favoritos
    if auth_user_id is not None:
        favorites_result = await session.execute(
            select(Favorites.submission_id)
            .where(Favorites.submission_id.in_(submission_ids))
            .where(Favorites.user_id == auth_user_id)
        )
        favorite_ids = {row[0] for row in favorites_result.fetchall()}
    else:
        favorite_ids = set()

    # monta response
    response = []
    for candidate_form in candidate_forms_submissions:
        candidate_submission_id = candidate_form["id"]
        if candidate_submission_id not in submission_mapping:
            continue

        cmap = submission_mapping[candidate_submission_id]
        if user_id is not None and cmap["id"] not in favorite_ids:
            continue

        mv = candidate_form["_mapped"]

        disabilities_raw = get_value(mv, "disabilities", "[]")
        if isinstance(disabilities_raw, str):
            disabilities_raw = json.loads(disabilities_raw)

        response.append(
            SubmissionSchema(
                id=cmap["id"],
                token=str(candidate_form.get("token")),
                name=get_value(mv, "name", ""),
                phone_number=get_value(mv, "phone-number", ""),
                email=get_value(mv, "email", ""),
                lattes_curriculum=f"http://lattes.cnpq.br/{get_value(mv, 'lattes_curriculum', '')}",
                nationality=get_value(mv, "nationality", ""),
                personal_website=get_value(mv, "personal_website", ""),
                gender=get_value(mv, "gender", ""),
                birth_date=get_value(mv, "birth_date", ""),
                graduation=GraduationSchema(
                    course=get_value(mv["graduation"], "course", ""),
                    country=get_value(mv["graduation"], "country", ""),
                    institution=get_value(mv["graduation"], "institution", ""),
                    year=int(get_value(mv["graduation"], "year", 0)),
                ),
                poscomp=(
                    PosCompSchema(
                        year=int(get_value(mv["poscomp"], "year", -1)),
                        score=str(get_value(mv["poscomp"], "score", "")),
                    )
                    if get_value(mv["poscomp"], "score")
                    and get_value(mv["poscomp"], "year")
                    else None
                ),
                current_occupation=get_value(mv, "current_occupation", ""),
                research=ResearchSchema(
                    program="",
                    field=ResearchFieldsSchema(
                        primary=get_value(mv["research"]["field"], "primary", ""),
                        secondary=get_value(mv["research"]["field"], "secondary", ""),
                    ),
                    semester=get_value(mv["research"], "semester", ""),
                    dedication_level=get_value(mv["research"], "dedication_level", ""),
                    will_apply_scholarship=bool(
                        str_for_bool(
                            get_value(mv["research"], "will_apply_scholarship", "False")
                        )
                    ),
                ),
                advisor=UserSchema(
                    id=-1,
                    name=cmap["advisor_name"],
                    email=cmap["advisor_email"],
                ),
                stats=cmap["stats"],
                is_favorite=cmap["id"] in favorite_ids,
                labels=[
                    LabelSchema(label=label.label, color=label.color, id=label.id)
                    for label in cmap["labels"]
                ],
                bidding_users=BiddingUsersSchema(data=cmap["bidding"]),
                accept=cmap["accept"],
                disabilities=len(disabilities_raw) > 0,
                ethnicity_race=len(json.loads(get_value(mv, "ethnicity-race", "[]")))
                > 0,
            )
        )

    return response

import os
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy import select, text
from src.infra.database.models.submission import Submission
from src.use_cases.dtos import UserDTO
from src.use_cases.submission.exceptions import SubmissionNotFound
from werkzeug.utils import secure_filename

import io
from fpdf import FPDF
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from datetime import datetime

def add_watermark(path_pdf, text):
    # removido para evitar timeouts
    # pensar em outrao slucao
    return io.BytesIO(open(path_pdf, "rb").read())
    try:
        reader = PdfReader(path_pdf)
        if reader.is_encrypted:
            return io.BytesIO(open(path_pdf, "rb").read())
        writer = PdfWriter()

        mark_pdf = io.BytesIO()
        pdf_mark = FPDF()
        pdf_mark.add_page()
        pdf_mark.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 12)
        pdf_mark.set_text_color(200, 200, 200)
        
        x = 5
        y = pdf_mark.h - 1.5
        pdf_mark.text(x, y, text)

        pdf_mark.output(mark_pdf)
        mark_pdf.seek(0)

        marca_reader = PdfReader(mark_pdf)
        mark_page = marca_reader.pages[0]

        for page in reader.pages:
            page.merge_page(mark_page)
            writer.add_page(page)

        pdf_final = io.BytesIO()
        writer.write(pdf_final)
        pdf_final.seek(0)
        return pdf_final
    except Exception:
        return io.BytesIO(open(path_pdf, "rb").read())

async def get_file_by_submission(
        submission_id: int, 
        label: str,
        filename: str, 
        session: AsyncSession, 
        session_forms: AsyncSession,
        auth_user: UserDTO
    ):
    # conferir se nome de arquivo é válido
    stmt = (
        select(Submission)
        .where(Submission.id == submission_id)
    )
    result = await session.execute(stmt)
    submission = result.scalars().one_or_none()
    
    if submission is None:
        raise SubmissionNotFound(submission_id)
    
    query = text("""
        select * from get_submissions_by_id(
            cast(:p_response_id as int),
            cast(:p_lang as text)
        )
    """)
    params = {
        "p_response_id": int(submission.candidate_form_id),
        "p_lang": "pt" 
    }
    result = await session_forms.execute(
        query,
        params
    )

    candidates_forms_submissions = dict(result.fetchone()._mapping)

    dict_responses = {k: v for d in candidates_forms_submissions['responses'] for k, v in d.items()}
    field = dict_responses.get(label, None)

    if field.get("value") != filename:
        raise

    safe_name = secure_filename(field.get("value"))
    url = f"/shared/uploads/{safe_name}"

    if os.path.exists(url):
        pdf_marked = add_watermark(url, f'{auth_user.email} - {datetime.now()}')

        return pdf_marked
    else:
        raise

from functools import lru_cache
import os
from typing import Annotated
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from src.auth.exceptions import UserNotAuthenticatedInSenhaunica
from src.infra.database.models.user import User
from src.infra.database.session import get_session
from src.settings import get_settings
from src.use_cases.dtos import UserDTO

FILE_PATH = "data/nusp_whitelist.txt"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(FILE_PATH), exist_ok=True)

async def get_user(
    request: Request,
    session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_session)]
) -> UserDTO:
    _settings = get_settings()

    # Local dev bypass: skip OAuth session check when APP_ENV=local and DEV_USER_ID is set.
    # The user row must already exist in the database.
    if _settings.APP_ENV == "local" and _settings.DEV_USER_ID is not None:
        user = await session.get(User, _settings.DEV_USER_ID)
        if not user:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=500,
                detail=f"DEV_USER_ID={_settings.DEV_USER_ID} not found in database"
            )
        return UserDTO(
            id=user.id,
            email=user.email,
            name=user.name,
            nusp=user.nusp,
            role=user.role,
        )

    user_id = request.session.get("user_id")

    if not user_id:
        raise UserNotAuthenticatedInSenhaunica

    user = await session.get(User, user_id)

    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="User not found")

    return UserDTO(
        id=user.id,
        email=user.email,
        name=user.name,
        nusp=user.nusp,
        role=user.role,
    )

@lru_cache
def load_whitelist():
    items = []
    with open(FILE_PATH, "r") as f:
        for row in f:
            row = row.strip()
            if row:
                items.extend(map(str, row.split(",")))
    return set(items)
